metaDescription: What your banks charged you in the last year, how to avoid each charge, and a ready request to ask for it back.
title: Bank charges
intro: Minimum balance penalties, SMS fees, card fees, ATM charges, bounced payments and the GST on them, found in your statements for the last 12 months they cover. Banks often reverse charges when asked.
empty: Upload a statement and Horizon finds every charge your bank took: minimum balance penalties, SMS and card fees, ATM charges and more.
none_one: No bank charges in the {count} month your statements cover. Nicely done.
none_other: No bank charges in the {count} months your statements cover. Nicely done.
askIntro: Banks often reverse charges when asked, especially a first one. Copy this request and send it from your registered email address, or paste it under complaints in the bank's app or website. It is in English, the language banks' complaint desks work in.
ombudsman: If the bank does not reply within 30 days, or you are not happy with its reply, you can complain to the RBI Ombudsman for free at cms.rbi.org.in.
homeText_one: Your banks charged you {amount} in the last {count} month of your statements.
homeText_other: Your banks charged you {amount} in the last {count} months of your statements.
tip_bounce: A payment (an EMI, NACH or cheque) failed because the money was not there. The bank charges for it, and the lender often adds a penalty. Keep the amount in the account the day before it is due.
tip_minBalance: Charged when the average balance falls below the account's minimum. Every bank must offer a Basic Savings Bank Deposit (BSBD) account with no minimum balance: ask to switch if this keeps happening.
tip_sms: A fee for SMS alerts, usually every quarter. Some banks waive it on request or on some accounts: ask yours.
tip_card: The debit card's yearly fee. If you hardly use the card, ask for a card with a lower fee, or close it.
tip_atm: Charged after the free uses each month. Under RBI rules: 5 at your own bank's ATMs, and 3 at other banks' ATMs in the six big metros (5 elsewhere). Fewer, larger withdrawals avoid it.
tip_late: Late payment fees, overdue or penal interest, or going over a limit. Paying at least the minimum by the due date avoids them; an auto-debit helps.
tip_forex: A markup on payments in a foreign currency, often 2 to 3.5% plus GST. A card with a low or zero markup costs less.
tip_transfer: Fees for NEFT, IMPS or RTGS. NEFT and RTGS done online from a savings account are free under RBI rules, so ask about these. UPI is free.
tip_chequeBook: Most banks give some cheque leaves free each year; extra books cost money.
tip_cash: Charged when cash deposits go over the month's free number or amount, or are made at another branch.
tip_statement: Charges for paper or duplicate statements and passbooks. Statements downloaded from net banking are free.
tip_gst: 18% GST added on top of bank fees. It goes away when the fee does.
tip_other: Other charges your bank took. Every bank publishes a schedule of charges: ask what each one is for.
